releaseNotes:
🛠️ 4.2 Update!

- Auto Click & Swipe: Direct Shizuku touch daemon, drag target UI, speed presets, position jitter, random intervals, and tap duration.

- Real-Time Hardware Monitor: New edit mode (drag/resize), pass-through touches, metric toggles, size presets, and setup sheet.

- Banking Mode: Added USB & Wireless Debugging toggles alongside Developer Options with auto-restore.

- Premium Sheet: Redesigned status sheet, local device sign-out option, and updated PayPal integration.
